summary: Aligned editor title sizing with settings titles, fixed shared sidebar left alignment and ellipsis behavior, unified Connected Apps settings layout, and moved settings outer spacing to the shared container.

acceptance_criteria.notes: Editor title input now uses the same title scale as settings headings.
Sidebar buttons now left-align content and truncate labels with ellipsis.
Sidebar project/object rows now left-align and truncate cleanly.
Connected Apps was rebuilt onto the same settings section/row pattern as the other settings pages.
Shared settings content container now owns the outer spacing.
Touched Russian UI strings were verified via UTF-8 file reads.
Typecheck and production build both passed.

utf8_check.command: Node UTF-8 spot check on touched files
